parameters.query:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE owner = 'vitor' AND status IN ('aberta','em_andamento')) AS minhas_abertas,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE owner <> 'vitor' AND status IN ('aberta','em_andamento')) AS delegadas_abertas,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('aberta','em_andamento') AND prazo IS NOT NULL AND prazo < now()) AS vencidas,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('aberta','em_andamento') AND prazo IS NOT NULL AND prazo >= now() AND prazo <= now() + interval '1 day') AS vencendo_hoje,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'concluida' AND concluida_em >= now() - interval '7 days') AS concluidas_7d
  FROM tarefas
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'stats', (SELECT row_to_json(stats) FROM stats),
  'minhas', (
    SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY (prazo IS NULL), prazo ASC, prioridade DESC)
    FROM (
      SELECT id, titulo, descricao, prazo, prazo_text, prioridade, evidencia, meeting_id
      FROM tarefas
      WHERE owner = 'vitor' AND status IN ('aberta','em_andamento')
      ORDER BY (prazo IS NULL), prazo ASC, prioridade DESC
      LIMIT 30
    ) t
  ),
  'delegadas', (
    SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY (prazo IS NULL), prazo ASC)
    FROM (
      SELECT id, titulo, owner, prazo, prazo_text, prioridade, meeting_id
      FROM tarefas
      WHERE owner <> 'vitor' AND status IN ('aberta','em_andamento')
      ORDER BY (prazo IS NULL), prazo ASC
      LIMIT 30
    ) t
  ),
  'vencidas', (
    SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY prazo ASC)
    FROM (
      SELECT id, titulo, owner, prazo, prioridade
      FROM tarefas
      WHERE status IN ('aberta','em_andamento')
        AND prazo IS NOT NULL AND prazo < now()
      ORDER BY prazo ASC
      LIMIT 20
    ) t
  )
) AS payload;
